$comment: Benchmark target list. Every entry was verified against the GitHub API on 2026-10-02: public, not archived, MIT-licensed, and small enough that the digest fits the context budget. 'realworld-control' is the labelled control because it is the repo already assessed by hand in examples/realworld-assessment. Commit SHAs are NEVER stored here: benchmark/run.mjs records the resolved commit (git rev-parse HEAD) into results/<name>/meta.json at run time, so a run is reproducible without pinning a SHA by hand. SAMPLING LIMITATION, stated up front: two of the four targets (target-2, target-4) are by the same author and share a Next.js house style, and three of four are TypeScript. This is a small, convenience sample of recognizable AI-built apps, not a representative one.
